What kind of AI automation agency this is

Dominion AI Agency is an AI automation agency for small local businesses: we configure the AI tools, put them on your phone line and website, and manage them month to month.

Some companies in this space sell a login and a tutorial. Some build one chatbot and move on. We work the other way: the founder, Maurice Johnson, sets up each client system himself and stays responsible for it afterward. There is no call center and no large staff, and every system is built on HighLevel rather than on homemade software.

The work covers the places a small business loses customers without noticing: calls nobody picks up, website visitors with a question at 10 p.m., inquiries that never get a follow-up, and happy customers nobody asked for a review.

What our AI automation agency services include

Each piece has its own page with the details and limits. Which ones you get depends on the package.

  • PhoneAn AI voice agent that answers calls around the clock, answers common questions from facts you approve, takes messages and books appointments; outbound calls are part of AI Pro.
  • WebsiteA chat and voice widget trained on the same facts, so the site and the phone give the same answers.
  • BookingAppointments booked into a calendar with your availability rules and email confirmations.
  • Follow-upCRM pipelines and automated email sequences, plus internal notifications and tasks for the steps that need you.
  • ReviewsReview requests sent to every customer after the job, by email for now.
  • MarketingLead capture, social media automation, a website and, on AI Empire, SEO pages: see AI marketing.
  • ReportingA summary of calls, leads and pipeline, monthly on AI Starter and weekly on AI Pro.

How the work is split between you and the agency

An AI system is only as good as the facts it answers from, and only you know those. This is the division of labor we work to.

You doWe do
Tell us your services, hours, service area and which prices may be quotedTurn that into the knowledge the voice agent and chat answer from
Decide which questions the AI must never answer and who gets which messagesWrite those rules into the agent and the routing, and test them with practice calls
Approve the greeting, the follow-up emails and the review requestDraft them in your voice and set the timing
Set up call forwarding with your phone carrier, with our instructionsConfigure the number, the after-hours behavior and the transfer rules
Tell us when something changes: a new service, holiday hours, a priceUpdate the agent, the chat and the workflows
Call the leads the system hands you and do the workReview call summaries, fix answers the agent handled badly, and send your report

Want to know what the finished product sounds like? Our own main line is answered by an AI voice agent we configured. Ask it what you would expect your customers to ask.

Why we build on HighLevel

One account, every piece

HighLevel combines a CRM, calendars, website chat, AI voice agents and workflows, so a call, a chat and an email about the same customer end up in one record.

Not a homemade tool

It is a widely used platform for small business marketing and automation, documented in a public help center. If we ever stopped working together, you would not be left with software nobody else understands.

The honest catch

We do not own or control HighLevel. Its features and screens change, and some connections to outside software work for one account and not another, so we confirm them for yours before promising anything.

What a month with the agency looks like

Setup is the start, not the job. Once the system is live, the monthly work is mostly small corrections that add up:

  1. Read the calls. We review call and chat summaries for questions the agent answered poorly or could not answer.
  2. Fix the facts. Wrong or missing answers get corrected and tested again.
  3. Keep it current. Holiday hours, new services, a new staff member who should get messages.
  4. Check the follow-up. Workflows that stalled or emails nobody opened get a look.
  5. Report. You get the summary your package includes, and a call with Maurice if something needs a decision.

Outbound calls and consent

Inbound answering is the core of what we set up. Outbound calling, included in AI Pro, needs more care. In February 2024 the FCC issued a declaratory ruling that calls made with AI-generated voices are "artificial" under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act, which means the consent rules for artificial and prerecorded voice calls apply to them. In practice we configure outbound calls for people who asked to hear from you: a callback someone requested, a confirmation for an appointment they booked, a reply to their own inquiry. Cold-calling purchased lists is not something we set up. This is a summary, not legal advice; your attorney can tell you what consent your calls need.

The FTC has made a related point about marketing: claims about what an AI product does must be true and supported. We hold our own pages to that, which is why each one lists what the system does not do.

Who this AI automation agency fits, and who it does not

A good fit

  • A local business whose customers call, book or ask before they buy
  • An owner who wants it done and maintained, not a course on doing it
  • Someone willing to spend an hour or two telling us how the business works
  • A business in any of the 50 states, since everything is set up remotely

Not a fit

  • Anyone who needs a custom AI model or a new software product built
  • A business that wants human call center staff on its line
  • Someone looking for legal, medical or HIPAA compliance work
  • A campaign to robocall or text people who never agreed to hear from you

What it does not do

  • Promise a setup date, a response time or a number of leads
  • Send texts before carrier approval clears
  • Give legal advice or act as a HIPAA compliance program
  • Price a job sight unseen on your behalf
  • Connect to your booking, practice or field service software until we confirm it for your account

AI automation agency questions

What services does an AI automation agency offer?

It depends on the agency; some only build chatbots, others sell software and leave the setup to you. Ours sets up and manages AI voice agents that answer and book, chat and voice widgets for websites, CRM pipelines with automated email follow-up, review requests, reporting, websites and SEO pages, all on HighLevel. We do not build custom AI models, staff a human call center or give legal or medical advice. For a general overview, read what an AI agency is.

Is there an AI automation agency near me?

We are a small agency in East Texas, and location does not limit the work. Everything is configured remotely: the AI voice agent picks up through call forwarding from the number you already have, the chat widget is a snippet added to your site, and setup happens by phone, email and shared screens. Small businesses anywhere in the USA can use it the same way.

How much does an AI automation agency cost?

Agencies price very differently, and many ask for a call before naming a number. Ours publishes it: AI Starter is $597 a month, AI Pro $1,097 a month and AI Empire $1,997 a month, with setup, training and support included in each. A single AI voice agent starts at $297 a month. The pricing page explains every line.

Will the AI make outbound calls for my business?

AI Pro includes outbound calling, and we set it up only for people who have agreed to hear from you, such as callback requests and appointment confirmations. The FCC ruled in February 2024 that AI-generated voices count as artificial voices under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act, so those calls generally need the recipient's prior consent. We do not run cold-call campaigns to bought lists. Ask your attorney about your own situation.

How long does it take an AI automation agency to set everything up?

We do not promise a date in advance, because it depends on how much the system has to know: how many services, how many people get messages, what software it has to work beside, and how quickly you can review the answers. The order never changes: learn the business, build, test with practice calls, go live on your line, then adjust. The how it works page walks through each step.

Hear the AI receptionist answer before you buy one

Call our main line. The AI receptionist that picks up is the same kind of agent we configure for clients, so you can test it with your own questions. Ask it about prices, setup or your industry, or leave a message for Maurice.
